verdict.rationale: Open WebUI has its own plugin system (Functions are modular Python plugins), and its site says to "share what you build, run what others share," which points to a first-party community sharing hub. Nothing in the evidence describes browsing that registry or installing from it with one click or one command. Missing for 10: documented browsable registry or marketplace, a one-click or one-command install flow, details on how skills or plugins are discovered and versioned, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, I can browse a real skills/plugins registry and install a capability with one command or click

citations.quote: Share what you build, run what others share.
Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
